## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

SensorPermissionLaunchStore — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/sensor/permission/SensorPermissionLaunchStore.kt

## Trigger

SensorPermissionManager's constructor and ConnectivityPermissionManager's constructor, both taking a launch-store collaborator — observed

## Today

SensorPermissionLaunchStore (app-wear) and ConnectivityPermissionLaunchStore
(core-domain) are declared as interfaces only — `isFirstLaunch()` /
`recordLaunch()` on each. SensorPermissionManager (app-wear) and
ConnectivityPermissionManager (core-domain) both take one as a
constructor collaborator and rely on it to prompt only on the first-ever
launch, but no class in main source implements either interface. The
only implementations are test fakes: `AlwaysFirstLaunchSensorPermissionLaunchStore`
and the anonymous fake in SensorPermissionManagerTest for the sensor
side; `FakeConnectivityPermissionLaunchStore`, `ScreenTestConnectivityPermissionLaunchStore`
and `CountingLaunchStore` for the connectivity side. `CURRENT_TECHNICAL_STATE.md`
documents both as "interfaces only; no implementation backs them ...
with ... persisted storage yet, only the fakes" in their respective
test files.

## Expected

SensorPermissionLaunchStore gets a SharedPreferences-backed
implementation in `:app-wear`, persisting the first-launch flag across
process death so a refusal or later revocation is never re-prompted
automatically.

Second gap: ConnectivityPermissionLaunchStore needs the same treatment,
but it is consumed from two application modules —
`HomeViewModel` in `:app-wear` and `ProfileViewModel` in `:app-phone` —
and `:core-domain`, where the interface lives, cannot hold
Android-dependent code per the module split. A SharedPreferences-backed
implementation is needed in each of `:app-wear` and `:app-phone`
separately, since neither exists today.
